notes.title: Patchnotes 1.1.0(04.09.2024)
notes.content:
[h1]Feature-Updates [/h1]

- [b][NEW][/b] Passthrough Option in Settings -> World
- [b][NEW][/b] Sitting Mode Option in Settings -> World . Default enabled
- [b][NEW][/b] Loading Screen added
- [b][NEW][/b] Models can now be positioned further into the ground depending on the position of the VR headset. This should make playing while sitting easier
- [b][NEW][/b] Hand Indicator Option in Settings -> Gameplay. Default enabled
- [b][NEW][/b] Tutorial is not mandatory anymore and will not be started on first start of the game
- Tutorial updates
- Couch Mode renamed to Compact Shelve
- UI updates
- Modelupdates
- Shelve Updates for levels with less then 80 Parts
- Radio Changes and radio repositions in Sitting Mode
- Player spawnposition adjusted
- Increased the field to grab the model
- Settings positions adjusted

notes.title: Patchnotes 1.0.7 (12.07.2024)
notes.content:
[h1]Feature-Updates[/h1]

- Tutorialupdates: We updated our tutorial to make sure every feature gets explained as best as possible.
- [b][HINT][/b] Some people were asking for a way to move the model, it was already possible and explained in the tutorial, you might have missed it. We think this is one of the essential mechanics of the game.
- [b][NEW][/b] Preperation for upcoming free Steam DLC

notes.title: Patchnotes 1.0.6 (25.06.2024)
notes.content:
[h1]Feature-Updates[/h1]

- [b][NEW][/b] Added cursor to the Audio-Player
- [b][NEW][/b] Added Achievements to the Demo

[h1]BUG-Fixes[/h1]

- Settings->Game Settings ui fixed
- Reworked the Achievementsystem, Achievement can now be unlocked in the Demo and the  Full Version seperatly
- Fixed Tutorial Floor
- Fixed Special Sounds for the Steamtrain Model

notes.title: Patchnotes 1.0.5 (20.06.2024)
notes.content:
[h1]Feature-Updates[/h1]

- [b][NEW][/b] Standard highlight for every Part in the Shelve
- [b][NEW][/b] Group highlight can be enabled in Settings, this Feature only works in hard difficulty and shows Parts of the same Group (medium difficulty)
- [b][NEW][/b] Added a language selection to the game settings
- [b][NEW][/b] Endsounds for every Model
- [b][NEW][/b] Radio mutes while Endsound is playing
- Hand menu is activated when you poke the palm into the item instead of the index finger tip.

[h1]BUG-Fixes[/h1]

- Language can now correctly be selected in Steam
- Language changes will be saved
- Some Languages had too long of a Text
- Tutorial will now properly start on first Launch
- Modelfix Lighthouse
